questions.question: Explain how click and bioorthogonal chemistries "liberated chemists from old constraints," according to Carolyn Bertozzi. / [CO1, CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain how click and bioorthogonal chemistries "liberated chemists from old constraints,"
  • according to Carolyn Bertozzi. / [CO1, CO3]
  • Answer: In her Nobel Prize Banquet Speech 2022, Carolyn Bertozzi explains that click and
  • bioorthogonal chemistries “liberated chemists from old constraints” by removing the need
  • for harsh conditions and complex procedures.
  • Earlier, chemists were limited to reactions that worked only in controlled laboratory
  • settings. These new approaches allow reactions that are fast, reliable and compatible with
  • living systems. As a result, chemists can now study and modify molecules directly inside cells
  • without disrupting natural processes, greatly expanding the scope of chemical research and
  • its applications in biology and medicine.
